2026-07-19 15:47:33.627492 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:

2026-07-19 15:47:33.627517 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-07-19 15:47:33.627523 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-07-19 15:47:33.627530 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-07-19 15:47:33.627536 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
2026-07-19 15:47:33.627542 | controller |   instance name specified.
